title: Unsafe deserialization of a client-supplied preferences token

defect.statement: The report preferences endpoint base64-decodes a client-supplied `prefs` request parameter and reconstructs a Java object from those bytes with ObjectInputStream.readObject(), so an attacker who sends a crafted serialized payload controls which classes are instantiated during deserialization.

evidence.summary: SYNTHETIC (04a2 wiring/accuracy test). The endpoint restores user preferences from a token by native Java deserialization of attacker-controlled bytes. The cast to ReportPreferences happens AFTER readObject(), so arbitrary classes are constructed first; with a suitable gadget chain on the classpath this yields remote code execution.
evidence.data_flow: 1. Source - `prefs` request parameter (@RequestParam), fully attacker-controlled. 2. Transform - Base64 decode to raw bytes. 3. Sink - ObjectInputStream.readObject() reconstructs an arbitrary object graph before any type check.
evidence.observed_behavior: A benign token round-trips a ReportPreferences object. A crafted token containing a gadget-chain payload (e.g. via a vulnerable library on the classpath) triggers class instantiation and method calls during readObject(), before the ReportPreferences cast is ever reached.
evidence.expected_behavior: The endpoint should accept only a well-defined, non-executable data format (e.g. JSON bound to a DTO). Untrusted input must never drive native Java object reconstruction.
evidence.impact: Confidentiality/Integrity/Availability (Critical): native deserialization of untrusted data is a remote-code-execution primitive when a gadget chain is reachable on the classpath; even without RCE it enables denial of service (deserialization bombs) and unexpected object instantiation.
evidence.detection_notes: Sink is `new ObjectInputStream(...).readObject()` on request-derived bytes; no ObjectInputFilter / resolveClass allow-list is configured. CWE-502 (Deserialization of Untrusted Data), OWASP A08:2021 Software and Data Integrity Failures. Not present in cwe-patterns.json or remediation-kb.json.
